jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Engineering
New York City | Hybrid

A high-growth technology company operating at the intersection of healthcare, data, and AI is seeking an experienced Director of Engineering
to lead and scale its software engineering organization.
This is a senior leadership opportunity for an engineering leader who has built high-performing teams, improved software delivery, and developed secure, scalable platforms in complex or regulated environments. Reporting into executive technology leadership, this person will oversee multiple engineering functions and play a key role in shaping the company's technical strategy as the platform continues to scale.
The Opportunity
The Director of Engineering will own software delivery across application development, quality engineering, and systems integrations. You will be responsible for making engineering delivery more predictable, maintaining high standards around security and reliability, and building an organization capable of moving quickly without sacrificing quality.
This role combines people leadership, technical strategy, operational excellence, and hands-on engineering judgment
. You will partner closely with Product, Data, and AI teams to translate ambitious business priorities into scalable technical solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and scale application engineering, QA, and integration engineering teams.
Manage and mentor engineering managers and senior engineers while continuing to build out the organization.
Own engineering delivery from planning through production, with a focus on predictability, quality, security, and uptime.
Help define the architecture and technical strategy for a scalable, cloud-based data platform.
Establish strong standards around testing, release management, observability, reliability, and technical quality.
Identify and address technical debt while balancing longer-term platform investments with near-term business priorities.
Embed security and compliance into the software development lifecycle without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams.
Partner closely with Product leadership to evaluate technical feasibility, establish realistic timelines, and break large initiatives into effective phased releases.
Introduce and expand the use of AI-assisted engineering tools to improve developer productivity, testing, documentation, and software quality.
Establish clear engineering processes and development standards that can scale alongside the organization.

Qualifications
10+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years in engineering management or leadership.
Experience managing engineering managers and leading multiple engineering functions or teams.
Proven success scaling engineering organizations in high-growth or rapidly evolving environments.
Strong technical background building secure, scalable cloud and data-intensive platforms.
Experience operating in healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or another highly regulated/data-sensitive industry.
Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, data integrations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, testing, and DevSecOps practices.
Track record of improving engineering delivery, release processes, reliability, and overall development quality.
Experience incorporating AI/ML or AI-assisted development tools into products or engineering workflows.
Ability to partner effectively with Product, Data, AI, and executive stakeholders.
Strong communication and leadership skills with the technical credibility to earn the trust of senior engineers.

Preferred Experience
Experience building platforms that ingest or integrate large volumes of external or third-party data.
Exposure to healthcare technology, healthcare data, life sciences, or related regulated environments.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability or data exchange standards such as FHIR or HL7.
Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Technical experience with languages such as Java, Python, Go, or similar modern backend technologies.
Experience implementing infrastructure as code, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern observability practices.
Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and evaluation frameworks.
Experience helping an engineering organization mature from an earlier-stage environment into a scalable, process-driven organization.

jobs.title: Director, Mobile & Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
SKIMS is a solutions-oriented brand creating the next generation of underwear, loungewear, shapewear, and essentials. We are setting new standards by delivering technically innovative, comfort-driven products with elevated design for everybody.

At the intersection of culture, innovation, and commerce, SKIMS is a global brand redefining modern apparel. Our teams are built on creativity, collaboration, and operational excellence, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance environment where ambitious, curious, and values-driven individuals can do the best work of their careers.

As we continue to scale globally, our HQ teams play a critical role in shaping strategy, building world-class infrastructure, and driving sustainable growth across markets.

We’re looking for a hands-on, highly collaborative Director of Mobile & Middleware Engineering
to lead two critical areas of our commerce technology stack: our cloud-based middleware platform and our native mobile application.

Reporting directly to the VP of Engineering, this leader will own the technical strategy, health, scalability, and delivery of our AWS-based middleware ecosystem
while also overseeing the engineering team responsible for our Flutter mobile application
.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at both the strategic and tactical levels. You should be able to set technical direction, develop strong engineering teams, partner closely with Product, Design, and other cross-functional leaders, and quickly step into complex technical situations when needed.

This role is particularly important in ensuring our platforms remain stable, resilient, and performant during high-traffic moments
, including major product launches, sales, and other peak commerce events.

Key Responsibilities

Middleware & Platform Engineering

Own the architecture, technical strategy, operational health, and ongoing evolution of our AWS-based middleware platform.
Provide technical leadership across services built primarily with TypeScript and Node.js.
Oversee deployment and infrastructure patterns using Serverless, ensuring services are repeatable, secure, scalable, and easy to operate.
Ensure middleware services are highly available, observable, resilient, and capable of supporting significant traffic spikes during major launches, promotions, and other high-volume commerce events.
Drive performance testing, capacity planning, caching strategies, failure recovery, and proactive remediation of scalability risks.
Establish strong engineering standards around API design, asynchronous processing, data access, fault tolerance, retries, graceful degradation, and service reliability.
Own integrations with the Shopify Storefront and Admin APIs, ensuring API usage is reliable, efficient, secure, and designed with platform limits and rate constraints in mind.
Oversee CMS integrations with Sanity, including content modeling, validation, and efficient data retrieval using GROQ queries.
Promote strong schema validation and data integrity practices using Zod across service boundaries, external integrations, and internal APIs.
Establish and maintain automated testing standards using Jest and ts-jest, with a focus on meaningful unit, integration, and regression coverage.
Drive strong observability and incident response practices using Sentry, including error monitoring, alerting, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation.
Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Product, Web, Mobile, QA, and Data teams to deliver dependable end-to-end commerce experiences.
Maintain a high-quality, stable, and well-documented codebase while balancing technical debt reduction, architectural improvements, and the need to move quickly.
Ensure teams can respond decisively to production issues, communicate clearly during incidents, and turn operational learnings into lasting platform improvements.
Evaluate and evolve the technology stack as business needs change, while maintaining pragmatic standards for reliability, maintainability, security, and cost.

Mobile Engineering

Provide engineering leadership and oversight for our mobile application built in Flutter and Dart.
Partner with Mobile Engineering leaders and individual contributors to establish technical direction, architecture, and engineering standards.
Ensure the mobile platform remains performant, scalable, maintainable, and reliable.
Own strong release management practices, including versioning, build readiness, phased rollouts, and publishing app releases through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
Oversee app-store submissions, review processes, release approvals, forced-update strategies, and production monitoring following each release.
Drive strong observability, automated testing, incident response, and production stability practices across the mobile platform.
Work closely with Product and Design to translate customer experiences into scalable technical solutions.
Experience with native mobile development is a strong plus, including iOS development with Swift or Objective-C and Android development with Kotlin or Java.

Engineering Leadership

Lead, mentor, and develop engineers and engineering leaders across Middleware and Mobile.
Create clear ownership and accountability while empowering teams to make strong technical decisions.
Build a culture focused on quality, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Establish engineering standards around architecture, code quality, testing, observability, documentation, and operational readiness.
Ensure teams can respond quickly and effectively when production issues or business-critical situations arise.
Balance speed and execution with long-term platform health and technical sustainability.
Identify technical risks early and proactively drive remediation.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product, Design, QA, Web Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and other cross-functional teams.
Participate in product and technical planning, helping teams understand complexity, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs.
Communicate technical topics clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
Help shape roadmaps by bringing an engineering perspective to product strategy and business priorities.
Build strong relationships across teams and operate with a team-first mindset.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What We’re Looking For

Significant engineering leadership experience managing high-performing software engineering teams.
Strong hands-on technical background in modern backend and distributed systems.
Deep experience with AWS and cloud-native architectures.
Strong experience with TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, and service-oriented architectures.
Experience designing and scaling systems that support significant traffic and transaction volumes.
Demonstrated experience preparing platforms for high-traffic events, peak demand, or rapid traffic spikes.
Strong understanding of reliability engineering, monitoring, caching, performance optimization, incident response, and fault-tolerant architecture.
Experience maintaining and modernizing large production codebases while continuing to deliver new capabilities.
Experience leading mobile engineering teams or working closely with native mobile platforms.
Familiarity with Flutter/Dart is strongly preferred.
Strong architectural judgment and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions quickly.
Experience working closely with Product and Design organizations in a fast-moving environment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role when:
Our Middleware and Mobile platforms remain stable and performant through peak traffic and major business events.
Engineering teams have clear technical direction, ownership, and accountability.
Production issues are identified quickly, resolved effectively, and translated into meaningful long-term improvements.
Middleware architecture continues to scale alongside the growth of the business.
Mobile engineering maintains strong release quality, performance, and customer experience.
Product, Design, and Engineering operate as close partners rather than independent functions.
Teams are able to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, maintainability, or engineering quality.

Leadership Profile

We’re looking for someone who is technically credible, calm under pressure, action-oriented, and highly collaborative.

This person should be comfortable diving deep when necessary while also giving their teams the autonomy and support needed to succeed. They should naturally bring people together, communicate clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and take ownership when problems arise.

Above all, this leader should care deeply about building great teams and dependable technology that can scale with the business.

Description & Requirements

The Director of Data & Intelligence serves as a senior leader within the Analytics and Applied Intelligence (AAI) practice and is accountable for the Data Foundation layer (Layer 1) of the firm's agentic intelligence framework, including the semantic fabric, vector stores, knowledge graphs, MCP connectors, and Zero-ETL pipelines that power autonomous systems and Client Zero solutions. This leader provides strategic direction, mentorship, technical coaching, and people leadership to the firm's Data & Intelligence Engineers, including professionals transitioning from Backend Data Designer and Data Engineer roles. Operating as a peer and key collaborator to the senior leaders of the AI Solutions Architects and Intelligence Designers teams, this role partners closely on solution architecture, end-to-end agentic delivery, and the development of Center of Excellence standards. The position follows a flexible hybrid work model with approximately 10% travel and requires availability during Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours. Due to project requirements, all professionals serving in this role must reside and perform all work within the United States. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States now and in the future. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire, and visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You Will Do

Lead the Data & Intelligence Engineering discipline across the AAI practice - setting technical direction, quality standards, and delivery patterns for the Layer 1 Data Foundation that supports delivery.

Provide coaching, career development, and performance feedback to Data & Intelligence Engineers.

Partner with peer leaders of the AI Solutions Architects and Intelligence Designers to define solution architecture, hand-offs across the three logic layers (Data, Reasoning, Validation), and shared standards for MCP, evals, and HITL.

Contribute to the AAI Center of Excellence (Hub) - selecting frontier tooling, codifying standards (Zero-ETL, vector DBs, knowledge graphs, MCP), and ensuring cross-team knowledge sharing.

Represent the practice on AI Ethics, model governance, data sovereignty, and responsible AI guardrails, in alignment with the AAI Steering Committee and Client Zero principles.

Architect and oversee the Data Foundation layer of agentic systems: vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus), knowledge graphs (Neo4j), semantic layers, and Zero-ETL / real-time streaming pipelines.

Thorough understanding of data modeling, relational, and non-relational principles; expert level SQL

Expertise in Python data engineering packages and patterns, including Python and PySpark

Familiarity and experience with the different data engineering platforms commonly used such as Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse

Solid leadership-level fluency with cloud fundamentals (Azure preferred, GCP, AWS) and modern data architecture (lakehouse, data contracts, governance, lineage)

Expected to actively collaborate with clients and team members to meet project objectives and timelines; Strong communication skills (verbal and written) for executive, client, and team audiences.

Experience with building, testing and deploying data pipelines, ML/AI models; understanding of GenAI/Agentic AI use cases (experience strongly preferred)

Set standards for Graph-RAG, RAG optimization, chunking strategy, and retrieval evaluation to minimize hallucinations and ensure high-quality context for downstream LLM components.

Partner with AI Solutions Architects to ensure data tools, semantic layers, and MCP services meet the needs of agentic workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) and frontier model integrations (GPT, Claude, Gemini).

Partner with Intelligence Designers to ensure data structures support HITL workflows, Action Centers, evals, and Golden Set testing.

Enforce row-/column-level security, federated identity (Entra ID / OAuth), and policy-as-code guardrails across all agent-accessible data.

Minimum Qualifications

BS in data science, computer science or other related fields (MS strongly preferred)

8+ years of relevant data engineering / data science experience, with demonstrated depth in modern data architecture (Zero-ETL, vector/graph databases, semantic layers, RAG)

7+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing teams of professionals (typically 5-10+), including senior individual contributors; consulting environment strongly preferred.

Proven track record partnering with peer technical leaders (e.g., solutions architecture, UX/interface design) to deliver integrated, multidisciplinary platforms.

Demonstrated experience deploying RAG architectures and MCP-based integrations in production environments, including evaluation frameworks (evals, RAGAS, Golden Set testing) for probabilistic systems.

Familiarity with AI Ethics, responsible AI guardrails, and governance frameworks suitable for enterprise and regulated environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in professional services or consulting, ideally leading a data engineering or applied AI practice area.

Experience translating client business problems into agentic data architectures (semantic layers, knowledge graphs, MCP tool design).

Hands-on exposure to LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) sufficient to coach engineers on integration patterns.

Meet the Team

The AI Platforms and Enablement team is the engine behind Cisco's internal AI transformation. Our mission is to build and scale CIRCUIT, Cisco's universal enterprise AI platform designed to collapse information silos and amplify productivity through intelligent, agentic experiences. As a team of researchers, engineers, and AI practitioners, we bridge the gap between powerful industry innovation and practical, production-grade applications.

We provide the foundation for Cisco to reimagine work through secure, scalable AI, enabling business units to integrate proprietary data and transform legacy workflows into intelligent, autonomous systems. We value technical depth, rapid prototyping, applied research, production engineering field, and solving complex architectural challenges across models, agents, harnesses, inference efficiency, and enterprise AI governance.

Your Impact

You will direct, mentor, and work alongside a specialized team of AI practitioners. You will contribute to architecture, code reviews, model evaluations, prototype implementations, and technical design decisions to ensure high-quality outcomes.
You will define Cisco-scale agentic system architecture, including planning, tool execution, agent-to-agent handoffs, memory, persistent state, human approval, policy enforcement, secure tool access, observability, and failure recovery.
You will build rigorous evaluation harnesses for models, prompts, RAG systems, tools, agents, and multi-agent workflows. You will establish offline and online metrics for task success, tool-call accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost.
You will own the strategy for frontier models, open-weight LLMs, SLMs, fine-tuned domain models, distilled models, and model routers. You will define when Cisco should use vendor-hosted models, self-hosted models, fine-tuned models, or task-specific small models.
You will continuously benchmark emerging LLMs, SLMs, and Agent Harnesses. You will lead fine-tuning of open-weight models to meet Cisco's security, domain, latency, cost, and quality requirements.
You will drive model-serving efficiency through routing, batching, caching, quantization, distillation, context optimization, structured outputs, and serving-stack improvements. You will own cost-quality-latency tradeoffs across production AI workloads.
You will track breakthroughs in AI research and translate them into production-grade capabilities, reusable platform primitives, and validated improvements to CIRCUIT.
You will establish technical standards for secure, observable, auditable, policy-compliant AI agents operating over Cisco enterprise data and systems.
You will accelerate internal AI development through better tooling, reusable agent patterns, evaluation frameworks, deployment pipelines, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
You will operate at the highest levels of Cisco’s internal AI infrastructure, managing significant platform scale, high-volume inference, and complex enterprise requirements.
You will own the optimization of a substantial annual model spend portfolio, drive critical reliability targets (p95/p99 latency, groundedness), and lead a multidisciplinary team of researchers and engineers. You will set the technical AI strategy in partnership with VP/SVP-level leadership across engineering, product, and security.
You will be measured on your ability to drive tangible improvements in AI productivity (hours saved, workflow cycle-time reduction), agent reliability (task completion rates, reduction in human overrides), model quality (groundedness, hallucination reduction), inference economics (cost per successful task, GPU utilization), and developer velocity (time-to-production, evaluation coverage).

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
15+ years or a PhD with 10+ years of combined experience in software engineering, systems architecture, machine learning, AI platforms or distributed systems.
Experience architecting or operating production LLM, agentic AI, model-serving, or applied AI systems at enterprise scale.
Demonstrated ability to build or lead evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG pipelines, tools, autonomous agents, or model-powered enterprise workflows.
Experience with model efficiency techniques such as model routing, caching, quantization, distillation, prompt/context optimization, batching, or high-throughput inference serving or similar work.
Deep expertise in AI/ML systems, model deployment, distributed platform design, applied AI architecture, and production software engineering practices.
Prior experience driving platform strategy and technical innovation at enterprise scale.
Demonstrated experience influencing product, engineering, security, infrastructure, and leadership organizations through technical strategy, architecture reviews, prototypes, and measurable platform outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree or equivalent experience (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
Demonstrated excellence in a Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, Director, or equivalent senior technical leadership role within AI/ML, distributed systems, or enterprise platforms.
Deep expertise in enterprise AI platforms, LLMs, SLMs, agentic systems, and model-serving architectures (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Ray, Kubernetes-based GPU platforms).
Proficiency in the full AI lifecycle, including model training, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), routing, compression, quantization, and inference optimization.
Extensive experience with agent runtimes, orchestration, tool-calling, human-in-the-loop workflows, memory management, and observability.
Proven ability to build rigorous evaluation frameworks, including golden datasets, adversarial testing, online experimentation, and release gates.
Strong understanding of enterprise AI security, policy enforcement, data privacy, and production-grade governance.
Demonstrated success in delivering complex AI business applications and translating powerful research into scalable, production-grade platform capabilities.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
